title: Dispatch release assessment
reference_policy:
Work on your own. Dockyard's hints and reference solutions are not available during the exam.
You may use command help (`--help`, `kubectl explain`, man pages), the Kubernetes documentation and blog, the Helm documentation, and any official documentation linked from a task.
Use the lab terminal, which is already connected to this exam's own cluster.
The two-hour timer starts once the environment is ready, and closing the browser does not pause it.
Keep the Dockyard launcher running so it can record the final state when time is up.
If the environment breaks or changes underneath you, the attempt is marked invalid rather than scored.

These are original practice tasks on a small local environment, without proctoring.
Your score shows how you did on these tasks today; it is not a certification result or a prediction of one.
The official rules change from time to time: before booking, read the [Linux Foundation allowed resources](https://docs.linuxfoundation.org/tc-docs/certification/certification-resources-allowed) and the [CKA and CKAD instructions](https://docs.linuxfoundation.org/tc-docs/certification/tips-cka-and-ckad).
These links were checked on 2026-09-27.
